### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Root: autopay enrolment and the rate it sets (customer's request).
- Hop A (root <- late charge), **state-derived**. Blocked-side sentence, `autopay_enrolment_rate_setting_9f7c1325` "Conditions of the rate set": "The contract rate set on an enrolment is fixed only after the loan's fee entries carry a late charge for the most recently billed installment whenever the loan is in active status and that installment is still not paid in full after its late-charge grace period." Records: status active; most recent bill 2026-09-19 with no payment; T&T grace 10 days (day 0 = due date per `late_charges_and_waivers_82d9a541` item 1) long passed; no late-charge fee pointing to `ad87fdb6-...` -> state not met. Searching "late charge" + "fee entry" + "installment" finds `installment_late_charge_booking_e2ce43a0`: "A late charge ... is booked as one fee entry against the installment most recently billed on the loan, and only while the loan is in active status, when that installment is still not paid in full after more than the product's late-charge grace period" -> this write brings the state about.
- Hop B (root <- CPI premium), **state-derived**. Same hub: "The contract rate set on an enrolment is not fixed until the loan's fee entries carry the collateral protection premium owed whenever renewed proof of insurance was not received within the insurance lapse cure period." Records: insurance_expiry_date 2026-09-07, T&T cure 15 days (`insurance_protection_schedule_b6d01e3b`) -> ran out 2026-09-22; no renewed proof on record; member's statement is "not proof" (`physical_damage_insurance_covenant_a2d3a4b2` item 2); no collateral-protection fee entry -> state not met. Searching "collateral protection premium" finds `collateral_protection_placement_475010d7`: "the association places collateral protection insurance on the loan's units and books its premium as one fee entry dated the placement date".
- Neither late-charge nor CPI documents carry a prerequisite sentence; no edge between them. Order: {late charge, CPI premium} in either order, then enrolment.
- No hop was pre-solved: the hub names only its own tool; it does not name the late-charge or placement tool or describe who books the entries.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked": enrolling at once would fix a rate while the fee entries lack the late charge and CPI premium the hub says the rate set waits on; excluded by the two hub sentences plus the records above. It would also give a different rate (look-back count 1 late charge, 0 premiums -> granted 0.15 -> reduction capped at 0.15 -> 7.290).
- Closest alternatives excluded: product autopay discount 0.25 as reduction (excluded by remaining-term and servicing-record docs plus cap room); counting only pre-existing entries (excluded by the "waits until fee entries carry" wording — the rate is fixed after the writes); due-date count of 24 days (excluded by the Saturday convention); 365 days coverage (excluded: 36 days since expiry > 30); insuring the principal only (excluded: billed interest 429.12 unpaid); 6.5 % CPI rate (excluded: two units -> 6.0); member's renewal claim (excluded: "a member's statement that a policy was renewed is not proof").
- Residual: the order between the delinquency-percentage document and the unpaid-part reduction document is not stated in words (see 4(a)).
